newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi, Syria's Assad discuss Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi, Syria's Assad discuss Mideast peace.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Syrian President Hafez al-Assad discussed latest setbacks to the Middle East peace process during a telephone conversation on Tuesday, a statement from Prodi's office said.
"The prime minister expressed concern over the current situation in the Middle East and over the dangerous halt to the peace process," the statement said.

It said Prodi had told Assad Italy was willing to work with other European Union countries and the United States to help revive the talks, which were halted by Israel after suicide bombings in Jerusalem last week.

Syria has been urging Europe, along with the United States, to play a bigger role in the peace process, and to persuade Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to return the Golan Heights, captured in the 1967 Middle East war, in exchange for peace with Syria.
